summary: Frontend-only test of DHARA Family Journey Phase 1 (Preview) on a 375x667 mobile web preview, logged in as voicetest2026@example.com. All 11 requested flows were run. The core feature works: Home card (home-family-journey-card) and Me row (me-me.familyJourney) open /family-journey. Hub master toggle starts ON and the PhaseNotice, Plan a journey, help row and SOS pill are present. The destination-required check works, and fields and check-in chips work. The picker merges on-device Trusted Circle contacts and accepted invites. Each of the 3 permissions asks for its own confirmation before turning ON, turns OFF at once with no confirmation, and does not affect the other two. The preview shows one card per contact per enabled mode with the exact copy and label. The active screen controls all work: check-in, arrived, change plan, previews, help request and stop. The overdue card reads 'Check-in not received' with neutral beige styling and no red. The Data & Privacy toggle shares state with the hub toggle, and the rest of that screen behaves as before. The Trusted Circle on-device list did not change. Network: the only app API call from Family Journey was GET /api/trusted-circle/accepted, with no POST/PUT and no notification/SMS/location call. BUGS found: (1) the master toggle state is stale on Home and Me, which are already-mounted tabs, until the app reloads; (2) the navigation stack piles up duplicate screens (router.replace pattern), so Back after Stop journey goes to an old Choose contacts screen; plus a few minor UX items. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

ui_bugs.issue: The hook reads AsyncStorage only once, in a mount useEffect, and each screen keeps its own copy of the state. Home and Me are tab screens that stay mounted. So after the user turns Family Journey OFF on the hub (or in Data & Privacy) and goes back, the Home card and Me row are STILL shown. They only disappear after a full reload (verified on the Me tab and on Home). On a native device this means the feature is not hidden 'everywhere' until the app restarts. Fix: re-read in useFocusEffect, and/or use a module-level subscriber or event emitter so every hook instance updates when setFamilyJourneyEnabled runs.

Two buttons use router.replace where they should go back. 'Back to journey' (fj-preview-back-active) replaces Preview with a NEW Active screen, and 'Stop journey' replaces Active with a NEW hub. Earlier screens stay in the stack. Seen in testing: 3 copies of fj-active-screen in the DOM after 'See all previews' → 'Back to journey' and 'Change the plan' → … → 'Back to journey'. After Stop journey, tapping Back on the hub opens an old /family-journey/contacts screen for a journey that no longer exists. Fix: 'Back to journey' should use router.back(), or dismissTo('/family-journey/active'). Stop journey and Start journey should use router.dismissTo / dismissAll + replace so the plan screens are cleared.

When the master switch is OFF, only the hub hides its content. /family-journey/new, /contacts, /preview and /active are still fully usable by deep link or stale stack, and an active journey stays 'active' in storage. Consider a guard that redirects these routes to the hub when the feature is disabled.
fj-new-error ('Add a destination label…') stays visible after the user types a destination, until Continue is tapped again. Clear the error inside onChangeText for the destination field.

issues: The global floating 'Help' FAB (bottom-right, about y 482-527) sits over the right-edge permission switches whenever a switch row scrolls behind it. During testing, a tap aimed at fj-mode-missedCheckin landed on the FAB and opened the full-red 'YOU MAY BE IN DANGER' emergency screen. Real users would hit the same accidental panic-screen opening. Consider extra right padding near the FAB, or hiding/offsetting the FAB on Family Journey screens.
fj-message-preview (arrival, help and missed check-in previews) shows both a 'Close' primary button and a 'Cancel' ghost button that do the same thing. Hide Cancel for preview-only sheets.
The back button (fj-back) is 40x40, below the 44pt minimum touch target.
The Family Journey row label is hardcoded English ('Family Journey') while the other rows use tr(key, lang). Hindi and other-language users will see English here.

action_items: HIGH: Make useFamilyJourneyEnabled reactive. Re-read on focus (useFocusEffect) and/or broadcast changes from setFamilyJourneyEnabled, so the Home card and Me row hide or show at once when the hub or Data & Privacy toggle changes. Today they need a full reload.

MEDIUM: Fix the stack build-up. fj-preview-back-active should call router.back() (or dismissTo active). Stop journey and Start journey should clear the plan screens (dismissTo('/family-journey') / dismissAll) instead of router.replace, so Back from the hub after Stop does not reopen an old Choose contacts screen.
MEDIUM: Stop the global Help FAB from blocking the right-edge switches on the Family Journey contacts screen. A tap meant for a switch opens the emergency panic screen.
LOW: Guard /family-journey/new|contacts|preview|active when the feature is OFF (redirect to the hub).
LOW: Clear fj-new-error when the user types a destination. Hide the redundant 'Cancel' on preview-only sheets. Make fj-back at least 44x44. Localise the Me row label.
critical_code_review_comments: Isolation holds: there is no fetch, Linking, notifications, location or SMS code in src/familyJourney or app/family-journey. getCircle is a read-only AsyncStorage read. listAcceptedRecipients is the existing GET /api/trusted-circle/accepted. saveCircle is never imported.

The git diff of home.tsx, me.tsx and data-privacy.tsx contains only additions (59 lines added, 3 lines changed). The changed lines are the Me rows type, the row label fallback, and the Switch import. Existing logic was not altered.
useFamilyJourneyEnabled defaults enabled=true before loading. Home and Me render the card or row optimistically even when the stored value is OFF, so it flashes on cold start.

All ConfirmSheets share the inner testIDs fj-confirm-yes / fj-confirm-cancel. This is fine on web, where only visible modals render, but scope them per sheet (for example `${testID}-yes`) for robust native testing.

success_rate.frontend: about 90%: all requested flows work; one HIGH stale-state bug and one MEDIUM navigation-stack bug

seed_data_creation: No server data was created. On-device only (fresh browser localStorage): TEST_Asha 9876543210 in the Trusted Circle and TEST_ journey records, which were cleared or exist only in a throwaway browser context. The server accepted invite 'QA Recipient Scoped' was only read. The master toggle for the test account was left ON.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fast auth: on /language, page.evaluate a fetch POST /api/auth/login, then set localStorage keys gk_token, gk_user, gk_consent_prefs, gk_consent_version='2026-10-01', gk_lang, lang_onboarded_v1_<uid>='1' and goto the target route. Family Journey storage keys: fj_journey_v1_<uid> and fj_enabled_v1_<uid>. You can seed an active or overdue journey directly to test the 'Check-in not received' card. Use ':visible' locators because duplicate stacked screens exist. Scroll the element to block:'center' before force-clicking right-edge switches, because the global Help FAB otherwise intercepts the click. The test account has one accepted invite (invite:acbe369c-…, 'QA Recipient Scoped'). /women-shield redirects to /women/panic-lesson on the first visit (expected). Data & Privacy grievance shows window.alert 'Simulated — nothing sent | mailto:…'. Register a page.on('dialog') handler that dismisses it, otherwise the page blocks.
rca_of_issue: Stale toggle: store.ts useFamilyJourneyEnabled keeps per-instance useState that is loaded once in a mount effect. Tab screens are never remounted, and setEnabled only updates the calling instance. Stack build-up: preview.tsx:104 and active.tsx:222 call router.replace to go to an existing earlier screen, which pushes duplicates instead of popping back.
